purpose: Opt-in Windows polling and local extraction of the canonical Prompt Kit website from web-excel-repair-triage.
knownTraps: Do not point the poller at a developer Prompt Kit checkout; it owns a separate managed source cache.
Do not infer a version from timestamps. The remote default-branch commit SHA is the version identity.
Do not reset, clean, or overwrite a dirty or diverged managed checkout. Fail closed.
Do not register the scheduled task without the explicit Enable action.
Do not auto-open a browser from scheduled polls. Open is an explicit operator action.
